independent_variables.name: Q-score_t
independent_variables.definition: Overall earnings-quality score equal to the equally weighted sum of Q^A and Q^B. Q^A is the change in the firm’s C-score from t−1 to t. Q^B is the year-t C-score minus the year-t median C-score among firms in the same two-digit SIC industry. The C-score is the estimated reserve from conservative accounting divided by net operating assets (NOA). The reserve is the sum of the disclosed LIFO inventory reserve, estimated capitalized R&D assets amortized with Lev and Sougiannis (1996) industry coefficients, and estimated advertising-created brand assets capitalized and amortized by the sum-of-the-years-digits method over two years. For non-LIFO firms the inventory reserve is zero. NOA is operating assets less operating liabilities, excluding financial assets and liabilities; the paper also supplies a Compustat-item implementation. A positive Q-score indicates reserve growth and a temporary depression of current earnings, while a negative score indicates reserve liquidation and temporary earnings inflation; the score is not an ordinal ranking of earnings quality. The exact Lev–Sougiannis coefficient schedule is not reproduced in this paper.
independent_variables.formula: C_it = (INVres_it + RDres_it + ADVres_it) / NOA_it; Q_it = 0.5 × (C_it − C_i,t−1) + 0.5 × (C_it − median_{two-digit-SIC,t}(C_it)). NOA = CommonEquity + FinancialObligations − FinancialAssets + MinorityInterest; CommonEquity = item60 + item227 − item242; FinancialObligations = item34 + item9 + item130 − item227 + item242; FinancialAssets = item1 + item32; MinorityInterest = item38.

evidence.quote: C_it = (INVres_it + RDres_it + ADVres_it)/NOA_it. INVres is reported LIFO reserve; RDres capitalizes R&D and amortizes using Lev and Sougiannis (1996) industry coefficients; ADVres capitalizes advertising and amortizes with sum-of-years-digits over two years. Q^A_it = ER_it/NOA_it - ER_i,t-1/NOA_i,t-1. Q^B_it = ER_it/NOA_it - industry_median(ER_it/NOA_it), with two-digit SIC industry median. Q_it = 0.5*Q^A_it + 0.5*Q^B_it.
Q_it = 0.5*(C_it - C_i,t-1) + 0.5*(C_it - industry_median(C_it)) = C_it - (0.5*C_i,t-1 + 0.5*industry_median(C_it)).
C_it = ER_it/NOA_it, where ER is the estimated reserve and NOA is net operating assets.
Net operating assets, NOA, is the book value of operating assets minus operating liabilities.

NOA = CommonEquity + FinancialObligations - FinancialAssets + MinorityInterest. CommonEquity = item60 + item227 - item242. FinancialObligations = item34 + item9 + item130 - item227 + item242. FinancialAssets = item1 + item32. MinorityInterest = item38. Item32 is labelled Investments and Advances - Other; the dash in that item label does not introduce an additional mathematical variable.
Inventory reserve (INVresit ) equals the LIFO reserve reported in the financial statement footnotes.

R&D reserve (RDresit ) is calculated as the estimated amortized R&D assets that would have been on the balance sheet if R&D had not been expensed. We capitalize R&D expenditures, then amortize them using the industry coefficients estimated by Lev and Sougiannis (1996).

Advertising reserve (ADVresit ) is the estimated brand assets created by advertising expenditures. We capitalize advertising expenses and then amortize them using a sum-of-the-year’s digits method over two years.
we weight the two measures equally
there were 22,313 non-LIFO cases (where the reserve is 0).

Positive Q-scores indicate the extent to which earnings are temporarily depressed by growth in investment in inventories, R&D, and advertising. Negative Q-scores indicate the extent to which earnings are temporarily inflated by a decline of investment in these three items.

review_notes: Selected Table 3 Panel A as the principal regression family: Section V tests whether the composite Q-score improves one-year-ahead core RNOA forecasts beyond current core RNOA. The source identifies this as the first research question and treats stock-return pricing as a separate second question; Table 3 Panel B is a subscore follow-up, and the stock-return, portfolio, robustness, and risk-control analyses are outside this selected family. The scope clarification was applied: the Q-score is a measure used to answer the substantive earnings-quality question, so its substantive relation test is retained.

The equation and formula fields use the coordinator-verified mathematical transcriptions already present in the supplied reading derivative. Physical PDF page 15 was rendered and inspected; no worker-generated math transcription was used.

No paper-estimated construction regression is required for the retained Q-score. The paper describes arithmetic reserve-based construction and cites Lev and Sougiannis industry coefficients for the R&D reserve; no such external construction fit is added as a dependency.

Unresolved source limits: the underlying estimator is not identified beyond “annual linear regressions”; per-year observation counts are not reported; the exact averaging convention for average NOA is not specified; the R&D industry coefficient schedule is cited but not reproduced; and the standard-error procedure/correction behind the reported coefficient t-statistics is unclear.
